snippet.title: GoSun
snippet.description:
Living off-grid or having plenty of power has never been easier. Whether you are a boater, RVer, love fishing, sailing, camping, van life, or want to live more independent, GoSun has a product you will love. . GoSun has developed breakthrough solar technologies that can cook, cool, light, charge, or purify using only the Sun.  And now our all electric boats and off grid trailers are available for rent, for adventures and fun. 
Founded in a garage in Cincinnati, Ohio, we grew quickly thanks to our community of committed customers and shareholders. Since our inception, we've worked with nonprofits to provide solar products to those in need. GoSun has provided funding and support to the American Red Cross, World Central Kitchen, Houston Food Bank, Global Giving, Operation BBQ Relief, Hawaii Salvation Army and the California Community Wildfire Relief Fund. GoSun has also donated to several Ukrainian relief organizations including Direct Relief, International Rescue Committee, and Unicef.
